scope: All 10 observed moderate families; authored easy polynomial and hard quotient evaluation
limitations: Three original formal-gradient component labels are mathematically wrong and remain in raw replay; repaired in normal practice.
Five raw/partly opaque banks reproduce parameterized expression patterns without claiming recovered distractor intent, and are evidence only.
Native radio ID tests validate selection; all displayed choices/solution math checked separately.

easy.formula: 10 nonzero coefficients per coordinate × 2 powers per coordinate; distinct gradients

moderate_symbolic.formula: 7 translated argument values per coordinate; all three affect displayed differentiated object

expcos_point.excluded_incidental: Signs ± of an integer-pi angle give identical cosine and zero sine, so not counted twice.

hard.canonicalization: same rational function and evaluated gradient; exclude duplicate points with identical gradient, banks/profiles/order never counted
